rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carefully selecting content or items to present, especially online or in media.

example.english: We curate a selection of local restaurants for the website.
example.traditional: 我哋精選咗一批本地餐廳，放上網站畀大家參考。

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone organizes and presents an exhibition or similar curated display as a curator.
